decisions: Use the Favorit-inspired black and #202024 section palette with silver text and no red or orange accents.
Use rgba(0,0,0,.4) with 30px backdrop blur for the glass navigation.
Use Onest for interface text and Unbounded for headings, prices and currency.
Use circular controls and dark capsule feature badges with silver circular icons.
Drive the two-row works gallery horizontally from vertical page scroll, matching the LANDOS reference behavior.
Remove decorative eyebrow text and estimated price from the booking form.
Use subtle lift and edge-only violet glow for feature capsules on hover; keep their idle state glow-free.
Hide hero carousel arrows and counter, and center the contact-card booking action.
Use violet for primary booking CTAs and a dark-gray left-to-right underline animation for desktop navigation while preserving its typography.
